description: Wrapped-prose layouts that clean differently from the generic expectation. flush_left_conventions are reviewed language rules. gaps are layouts the sanitizer does not clean yet; that list may only shrink. See tests/test_comment_wrapped_prose_matrix.py.

flush_left_conventions.reason: Reviewed ASL and UEFI headers (/** @file followed by indented text) clean to flush-left lines.
An unclosed Clue /* comment is indentation-scoped, so its continuation indent is source indentation.

gaps.reason: Cleaning keeps the space after the backslash, as existing linear_programming tests pin, while the cleaning policy removes one padding space. Needs a decision.
